findings.issue: Niphal imperfect 3ms has glory-of-Jehová as its masculine singular subject and את marks all the earth as direct object, so the glory fills the earth. Passive feminine “será llenada” makes its subject the thing filled; bare “gloria de Jehová” and “toda la tierra” do not keep glory as filler and the earth as object.
findings.spanishSpan: será llenada gloria de Jehová toda la tierra

notes: Pero vivo yo matches the adjective plus 1cs pronoun; Jehová matches the proper name.
